title: Meetings
description: Recordings members shared here, with Leo’s summary, decisions and tasks.

empty.title: Nothing shared yet
empty.text: Meetings arrive when a member shares one of their recordings, or when a meeting with only {workspace} members ends and the sharing rules apply.

noMatch.title: No meetings match
noMatch.text: Try other words, another team, or all meetings.

meeting.participantsWithGuests: {names} ({count, plural, one {# person from outside {workspace}} other {# people from outside {workspace}}})
meeting.recordedByYou: Recorded by you. It’s also in your Notes; stop sharing any time and it stays there.
meeting.transcriptPrivate: {name} kept the transcript private. Ask them if you need the exact words.
meeting.transcriptPrivateUnknown: The organizer kept the transcript private. Ask them if you need the exact words.
meeting.unavailable: It doesn’t exist, it hasn’t been shared with you, or its owner stopped sharing it.

audience.participantsHint: Members who were in the meeting.
audience.workspaceHint: Everyone in the workspace, now and later.
audience.sharedWith: {level, select, participants {Shared with participants} workspace {Shared with everyone at {workspace}} other {Shared with {team}}}
audience.sharedToast: {level, select, participants {“{title}” is shared with participants in {workspace}} workspace {“{title}” is shared with everyone at {workspace}} other {“{title}” is shared with {team} in {workspace}}}

share.lockedHint: Only the person who shared it, or an admin, can change who sees it
share.title: Who sees this meeting
share.description: The summary, decisions and tasks. Questions people ask Leo stay their own.
share.external: People from outside {workspace} took part. Share only what they’d be comfortable with.
share.includeTranscriptHint: Otherwise only the summary is shared.
share.summaryOnly: Only the summary is shared now
share.stopMine: Stop sharing (keep it in my Notes)

shareDialog.allShared: All your recordings are already in {workspace}.
shareDialog.title: Share one of your meetings
shareDialog.description: It stays yours and stays in your Notes; {workspace} sees it until you stop sharing.
shareDialog.movesFrom: It’s shared in {workspace} now; sharing it here moves it.
shareDialog.audienceHint: Its decisions and tasks come along; participants can always see it.
